_comment: Celestan requests capabilities, not vendors. This file selects adapters. Replace without changing Celestan code.

_notes.model_provider: OpenRouter only for the prototype; bind exact runtime secret OPENROUTER_API_KEY, set CT_RUNTIME_FREE_ONLY=true and a $0 spend limit. First unattended model: openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free. Provider/rate-limit failures defer the same launch with a bounded retry wake; no paid fallback.
_notes.durable_state: postgres adapter is standard Postgres (works with Neon/Supabase/self-hosted). Binding stays 'postgres' if you switch provider — only connection string changes.
_notes.evidence_store: s3 adapter is S3-compatible (AWS S3/Backblaze B2/R2/MinIO). Switch provider by changing endpoint/region, binding stays 's3'.
_notes.knowledge_publishing: Celestan calls: publishChronicle({ period, markdown }) via knowledge_publishing. Adapter is 'git' today, 'confluence' tomorrow — Celestan unchanged.
_notes.project_system: Celestan calls: listWork({ project }) via project_system. Adapter varies per project; BorderCrossing uses Jira, others use GitHub Issues.
